description: List or search the public plugin library, one page at a time, most liked first. Returns `{items, nextCursor}` with no total; for the next page pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same `query` and `category` (a cursor is invalid with other values). Readable with any project token.

category.description: Only entries of this category (CLI: --category). One of: programming, testing-qa, security, devops, design, productivity, other.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

name: library_list
title: List library entries
